documents.title: Doc 91 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 1 - Causing a collision
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 1 - Causing a collision

details.fact: Car 1 (Camara) made side-to-side contact with Car 7 (Beganovic) at Turn 10 and gained the position from him.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Five (5) seconds time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (a) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 1 point to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 1 point.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. Having considered the matter extensively the Stewards determine that Car 7 (BEG) on the outside was slightly ahead of Car 1 (CAM) at the entry to Turn 10. BEG left sufficient room for CAM on the inside at the apex but CAM had slight understeer which caused him to miss the apex by a bit and have slight side-to-side contact with BEG. CAM gained the position and retained it which is the reason the Stewards have decided to act. The Stewards determine that CAM is wholly responsible for the collision. The standard penalty has been mitigated in this case due to the minor nature of the contact.

documents.title: Doc 89 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 8 - Leaving track and gaining advantage
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 8 - Leaving track and gaining advantage

details.fact: Car 8 (Bilinski) cut the chicane at Turns 13-14 while defending against Car 1 (Camara) and retained the position as a result.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Ten seconds time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video & GPS evidence. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 8 (BIL) was defending against Car 1 (CAM) approaching Turn 13. CAM on the inside had significant overlap with BIL. BIL, through no fault of CAM, went off track at 13 and rejoined after Turn 14 still in front of CAM. In such cases, it is not enough for the gap between the cars to merely remain the same. Failing to lose a position after leaving the track while defending constitutes gaining an advantage. BIL is penalized for remaining in front of CAM by doing so.

documents.title: Doc 86 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 25 - Unsafe release
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 25 - Unsafe release

details.fact: Car 25 (Bennett) was released into the path of Car 23 (Villagomez).
details.infringement: Breach of Article 28.12 (a) of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations and breach of Article 12.2.1.h of the FIA ISC.
details.decision: Drive-Through penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (c) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. As the penalty could not be served in the race it is converted into a twenty (20) seconds time penalty. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement. In addition, a fine of 10,000 Euros to be paid by the Team. Pursuant to Article 12.4.6 of the International Sporting Code, 5,000 Euros of the fine is suspended for the remainder of the 2026 Formula 2 season subject to no further breach of Article 28.12 (a) of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations. In accordance with Article 12.8.1 of the ISC, fines shall be paid within forty‐eight hours of their notification by means of bank transfer to the FIA.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. After the Race had concluded the Stewards summoned and heard (documents 80 and 81) the drivers and team representatives to discuss the matter further. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determine that the team released Car 25 into the path of Car 23. Both cars were forced to take major avoiding action. Car 25 also struck a wheel of Car 1 that was lying on the ground causing the wheel to strike the leg of Car 1’s lollipop man. Based on the gravity of the offence, the Stewards determined to issue a fine to the Team in addition to the standard sporting penalty for creating the unsafe situation for other personnel in the pit lane.

details.reason: The Stewards summoned and heard the drivers and team representatives (documents 78 & 79). The Stewards examined video evidence. documents.title: Doc 73 - DECISION - Car 11 - Allegedly driving unnecessarily slowly
documents.subject: DECISION - Car 11 - Allegedly driving unnecessarily slowly

details.fact: Car 11 (Montoya) slowed slightly while contesting position with Car 12 (Boya) approaching the DRS detection zone after Turn 10.
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: No further action
details.reason: The Stewards summoned and heard the driver and team representative (Document 60). The Stewards examined video and GPS evidence. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 11 (MON) slowed slightly when he realized that Car 12 (BOY) in front of him was driving significantly slower than normal in an attempt to gain a DRS advantage on the following straight. While MON’s reaction was part of the same DRS strategy, the magnitude of his throttle delay was quite slight. Had BOY’s speed not drawn attention to the situation, MON’s speed and throttle usage would not have been noticed by the Stewards. Under the circumstances, the Stewards elect to take no further action.

documents.title: Doc 72 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 22 - Out of position at first SC line
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 22 - Out of position at first SC line

details.fact: Car 22 (Varrone) failed to enter the pit lane after being out of position at the first safety car line.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 37.8 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Ten second Stop & Go Penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (d) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations, as specified in Article 37.8 of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement. The penalty, while not fully served during the Race, was nevertheless served to the satisfaction of the Stewards.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned and heard the driver and team representative (Document 56). They examined video and GPS evidence. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 22 was delayed leaving the grid and was passed by one car. Car 22 did not re-establish the original grid starting order before reaching Safety Car Line 1 and proceeded to start the race from his assigned grid position rather than entering the pits and starting from the end of the pit lane. The penalty specified by the regulation, a ten-second stop-and-go penalty was communicated by the stewards to Race Control. The message that was posted to the teams on Timing Page 3 said “Stop–And-Go”. Car 22 (VAR) entered the pit lane in due course came to a stop in its pit box and immediately departed without stopping for ten seconds. The stewards note that while a mere stop-and-go penalty is not among the listed penalties provided under Article 39.3, it is a penalty allowed by Article 12.4.1.l of the International Sporting Code. The team, having served the posted penalty, bears no fault in failing to serve the intended penalty. The stewards surmise that the confusion stems from the fact that the in the Formula 1 regulations, a stop-and-go penalty by definition includes an obligation to stop for ten seconds. Such is not the case within the F2 Sporting Regulations. Given the gap between the series regulations, it is imperative that penalty announcements in Formula 2 and 3 be made be made with clarity in these circumstances.

documents.title: Doc 71 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 10 - Not following RD instructions
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 10 - Not following RD instructions

details.fact: Car 10 (Goethe) went off at Turn 13 and went through the infield and rejoined the racing surface, crossing the orange kerb rather than following the Race Director's instructions.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code in conjunction with Item 27.3 of the Race Director’s Competition Notes.
details.decision: Reprimand given to the Driver of Car 10. This is his first Driving Reprimand of the 2026 Season. There are no penalty points associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. The drivers were informed by the FIA Race Director during the Drivers Meeting that drivers who fail to negotiate Turn 13 must pass to the LEFT of the orange kerb and rejoin at the far end of the run-off. Driver of Car 10 did not make the corner and crossed a portion of the kerb contrary to the Race Director's instructions. While the breach was slight and the re-entry was safe, the Stewards did not observe any extenuating circumstances for not following the Race Director's instructions in this instance.

documents.title: Doc 69 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 - Unsafe release
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 - Unsafe release

details.fact: Car 4 (Herta) was released unsafely from his pit into the path of Car 16 (Maini).
details.infringement: Breach of Article 28.12 (a) of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Warning
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 57 and 58) and heard the drivers and team representatives of Car 4 and Car 16 and reviewed video evidence. The crew of Car 4 released him from the pit box with Car 16 approaching in the fast lane. The driver of Car 16 had to take minor braking action but acknowledged that the driver of Car 4 slowed and altered his course in response to the situation. The driver of Car 16 did not believe that it presented him with danger. The team representative for Car 4 stated that he spoke with the crew member responsible and acknowledged that they took responsibility for the poor timing of the release. The stewards determine that the release was unsafe when made and issue a warning in large part due to the account of the affected driver.

documents.title: Doc 68 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 12 - Driving unnecessarily slowly
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 12 - Driving unnecessarily slowly

details.fact: Car 12 (Boya), while contesting position with Car 11 (Montoya), drove unnecessarily slowly approaching the DRS detection zone triggering a collision between following cars.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 1 point to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 1 point.
details.reason: They summoned and heard the driver and team representative (Documents 61). The Stewards examined video and GPS evidence. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 12 (BOY) delayed in applying the throttle on the exit of Turn 10 because he did not want to be at a DRS disadvantage to Car 11 (MON) on the following straight. This was highly unpredictable to the following cars who applied the throttle normally and found themselves closing on BOY at a surprising rate. Car 22 (VAR), the first trailing car checked up, but Car 21 (SHI), the second car, did not have sufficient time or space to react and had nose to tail contact with VAR further causing VAR to collide with MON. The stewards determine that BOY drove unnecessarily slowly in a manner that proved to be dangerous to other cars and impose the baseline penalty for driving infractions. All drivers are reminded that predictability is one of the cornerstones of safety. The stewards note that the single penalty point imposed here is light for a corresponding 10 second penalty but feel that it is appropriate for this case of first impression. Future similar infractions may warrant increased points. While BOY received a penalty in this case, the stewards are pleased to note his exceptional candor and integrity during the hearing.

documents.title: Doc 66 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 6 - Causing a collision
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 6 - Causing a collision

details.fact: Car 6 (Tsolov) made contact with Car 14 (Stenshorne) who in turn hit Car 25 (Bennett) at Turn 10.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 2 points.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. Having considered the matter extensively the Stewards determine that Car 25 (BEN) was leading Car 14 (STE) and Car 6 (TSO) into turn 10. STE and TSO simultaneously moved right just before the braking zone. TSO had no reason to anticipate that STE would make the same move and moved left to try to get back into the clear but in so doing clipped the left rear of STE who in turn collided with BEN causing him to spin and lose positions. The Stewards determine that TSO is wholly at fault for the collision and apply the standard penalty.

documents.title: Doc 65 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - Unsafe act
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - Unsafe act

details.fact: Driver of Car 2 (Duerksen) exited his retired car in run-off area of Turn 10 standing close to the live track.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1h of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Reprimand (non driving) given to the Driver of Car 2. This is his first Reprimand of the 2026 Season. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (document 59) and heard from the driver and team representative and reviewed video evidence. After crashing out of the race at Turn 10, the driver of Car 2 stopped his car in the run-off area, exited and approached the edge of the track which was under Safety Car conditions to gesture at another driver. The Driver realized the unsafe situation, taking fully responsibility for the fact and apologized for the action. The Stewards, having analysed the matter, consider that standing close the track is extremely dangerous. Therefore, the Stewards elect to reprimand the driver, that receiving a certain number of reprimands during a season will draw a significant penalty in accordance with Article 18.2 of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations.

documents.title: Doc 49 - DECISION - Car 22 - Alleged failure to follow RD instructions
documents.subject: DECISION - Car 22 - Alleged failure to follow RD instructions

details.fact: Car 22 (Varrone) went off at Turn 8 and went through the grass rather than following the Race Director's instructions
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code in conjunction with Item 27.2 of the Race Director’s Competition Notes.
details.decision: No further action
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. They summoned and heard the driver and team representative (document 29). The drivers were informed by the FIA Race Director during the Drivers Meeting that drivers who fail to negotiate Turn 9 should use the pavement behind the grass and rejoin after the end of the orange kerb. Driver of Car 22 locked his wheels under breaking for Turn 8, but thought that he would be able to make the corner and turned in do so. By the time he realised that he would not make the corner, taking the escape road was no longer a safe option and he went across the grass. The Stewards accept these extenuating circumstances as a valid reason for not following the Race Director's instructions in this instance. Accordingly the Stewards elect to take no further action.

documents.title: Doc 47 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 1 - Impeding car 15 in Qualifying
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 1 - Impeding car 15 in Qualifying

details.fact: Car 1 (Camara) impeded Car 15 (Dunne) at Turn 10.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the FIA International Sporting Code and Article 31.6 of the 2026 FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A drop of 3 places on the grid for both races at this Competition. There are no penalty points associated with this decision.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. They summoned and heard the Drivers and Team Representatives (Documents 36 & 37). Car 1 (CAM) was on a prep lap with Car 15 (DUN) was approaching on a push lap. CAM received a message from his engineer to begin pushing and picked up his pace. DUN caught CAM in the braking zone for Turn 10 and moved inside to pass. CAM who thought both drivers were on the same prep strategy did not yield and impeded DUN’s lap. CAM did not receive a warning from the team which was preoccupied by trying to get CAM to the line before time expired. The stewards accept that CAM’s action was the result of an erroneous assumption but determine that he unnecessarily impeded DUN. The standard penalty is applied.

documents.title: Doc 46 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 15 - Impeding car 23 in Qualifying
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 15 - Impeding car 23 in Qualifying

details.fact: Car 15 (Dunne) impeded Car 23 (Villagomez) at Turn 2.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the FIA International Sporting Code and Article 31.6 of the 2026 FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A drop of 3 places on the grid for both races at this Competition. There are no penalty points associated with this decision.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. They summoned and heard the Drivers and Team Representatives (Documents 31 & 32). Car 15 (DUN) was approaching Turn 2 on a cool down lap with three cars pushing behind. DUN appropriately let the first two cars through by staying left at Turn 2 but did not realize that Car 23 (VIL) was also approaching. DUN moved right just as VIL was passing him on that side. DUN immediately corrected course once he became aware of VIL, however by this time VIL had to take evasive action. Having considered the matter extensively the stewards determine that DUN unnecessarily impeded VIL and elect to impose the standard penalty.

documents.title: Doc 24 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 5 - Impeding of car 24
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 5 - Impeding of car 24

details.fact: Car 5 (Leon) unnecessarily impeded Car 24 (Van Hoepen) at Turn 3.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Warning
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 17 & 18) and heard the drivers of Car 5 (Leon) and Car 24 (Van Hoepen) and both team representatives. The Stewards examined video evidence. Driver of Car 5 stated that he was in a warm-up lap and he received a late message to let by the car behind. Driver of Car 24 stated that he was in a push lap and car 5 was travelling in the racing line not a full pace and he was impeded. Having analysed the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 5 could have done more to avoid an unnecessary impeding which happened at Turn 3. In this specific point, Car 24 did not take reasonable actions to avoid impeding and therefore the Stewards, keeping with the Penalty Guidelines, give a formal Warning to the driver of Car 5.

documents.title: Doc 23 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 16 - Erratic driving
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 16 - Erratic driving

details.fact: Car 16 (Maini) drove erratically at 10:21 in Practice
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Reprimand given to the Driver of Car 16. This is his first Driving Reprimand of the 2026 Season.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. They summoned and heard the drivers and team representatives (documents 11 & 12). Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determine that Car 16 (MAI) who was on a push lap came upon Car 22 (VAR) who was on the line in the braking zone for Turn 10. MAI locked his brakes while passing VAR, went extra deep into the corner, and ended any chance at a good lap. MAI’s lockup and recovery also forced VAR to abandon the normal line and go off track. On the ensuing straight MAI drove slowing and was noted to be actively watching his mirrors. VAR decided to pick up his pace and attempted to pass MAI. MAI who was admittedly unhappy with VAR reacted by moving towards VAR, and ultimately crossed in front of him to prevent him from passing. While VAR was not on a push lap the Stewards determine that MAI’s driving in reaction to his displeasure with VAR was erratic and potentially dangerous. The Steward’s note that with the slightest miscalculation such actions can trigger major consequences. The Stewards determine to issue a driving reprimand to MAI during this practice session. This decision should not be taken a precedent for similar offences in the future which may warrant increased penalties.
